notes: Family farm run by Joe Weber on over 400 acres in Central Kentucky; contact page gives a Salvisa (Mercer County area) address. Read homepage, about, pickup locations, grass-fed beef store and contact pages (WebFetch summaries, Verifier should recheck the quote). Beef store page says 100% grass-fed and finished; poultry described as pastured with no diet detail. Online ordering with pickup windows at pickup locations and home delivery in some zip codes, but the locations list loads by script and no sites or zip codes were readable, so farm-pickup not claimed. Also sells to restaurants. Only 20 to 40 lb bundles, no quarter or half shares. Most beef cuts showed sold out.
